The listing sorts on `pubDate` descending, so this post is expected to appear
above the older one.

## 唯一の見出し

Exactly one heading, and the count is the point: src/lib/toc.ts asks for two entries
before a contents is worth a column, so this post is the side of that floor where
nothing is rendered. A second `##` here would give this post a contents and leave the
assertion that one heading produces none with nothing left to catch. It is a test
fixture, not decoration -- 2026/08/01 is the post to add headings to.
